charts.title: Kepler-90 i: orbits around Kepler-90
charts.description: The orbits of Kepler-90's planets in this map from above, to scale, with Kepler-90 i highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Shallue & Vanderburg 2018 (2018AJ....155...94S), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname SHALLUE__AMP__VANDERBURG_2018): P 14.44912 d

charts.title: Kepler-90 i: its transit
charts.description: Kepler-90 i crossing its star, as Kepler recorded it: 14 quarters (1 to 7, 9 to 11, 13 to 15, 17) of the Kepler pipeline's 30-minute light curves of KIC 11442793, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 14 minutes earlier to where Kepler measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 21 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 30-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on Kepler's dip, 14 min early; 30-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 7 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
